name: Midway Meadows

otherUses.text: Uses customarily incidental to the residence, in the same dwelling, as a secondary use by the immediate family only
otherUses.quote: uses customarily incidential thereto when situated in the same dwelling

sideSetbackMin.quote: Side yard - 5 ft. with 10 ft. at street side of corner lots

rearSetbackMin.quote: Rear yard - 12 ft. with 20 ft. at rear entry garages

unitSizeMin.quote: Minimum dwelling unit area - 1200 sq. ft. of living area

review.base: Section 2 applies "the use restrictions, height restriction, and area restrictions as setforth in R-1 Single Family Dwelling District" of the 1978 Zoning Ordinance No. 66. Mapped to UDC R-1, so today's R-1 limits (such as 35 ft height) show where this PD sets none.
review.uses: Section 2 allows only single-family and two-family residences plus incidental uses. Two-family mapped to duplex; zero-lot-line lots are single-family detached.
review.ordinances: Ordinance 461 created Planned Development District No. 6. The Midway Meadows standards on pages 6-7 are attached development plans (Section 2(a)). Pages 6-7 have a poor text layer; values were read from the page images, including the zero-lot-line lot depth (115 ft) that the text layer dropped.
review.acres: The ordinance describes 59.6144 acres; the current map shows 46.4 acres for PD 461.
review.frontSetbackMin: Zero-lot-line: 20 ft at front-entry garages; 10 ft at screening walls, porte-cochere, or faces of the main residential building.
review.sideSetbackMin: Zero-lot-line: 3 ft at the "zero" setback line, 7 ft on the opposite side. Single family detached and duplex: 10 ft on the street side of corner lots.
review.rearSetbackMin: 20 ft at rear-entry garages, all lot types.
review.lotCoverageMax: Includes accessory buildings; excludes swimming pools and cabanas.

notes: 70% masonry exterior below the first-floor ceiling plate line. Two off-street parking spaces per dwelling unit. 5 ft sidewalks in the single family detached area. Development phasing tied to Ordinance Nos. 459 and 460 (Section 2(b)).
